correctness.rationale: The exact Markov jump chain has four rates derived from all available edge counts. Uniform fluid convergence on finite time intervals, and two exact rational generator inequalities for 2C/L and NC/L^2, control the growing-time stopping boundary. The stopped weighted difference martingale has explicitly converging quadratic variation and negligible jumps. Terminal parity identifies U with |D| and the final C contribution is o(sqrt N). The exact labeled-state and coarse-state recursions agree for four small cases, and an independent quadrature matches the analytical bracket. Only the probabilistic argument proves the infinite-family claim.

originality.rationale: The only inspected related full primary paper, Gamarnik--Goldberg arXiv:0807.1277v1, proves regular/high-girth or bounded-degree results, not a dense three-block absorbing-state folded-normal theorem. Related earlier fixed-part multipartite laws only imply vanishing macroscopic density at tied maxima; their quantified scope cannot give the critical square-root law. A complete-split theorem instead has macroscopic nonzero jamming and an ordinary centered Gaussian law. Targeted semantic and web queries found no equivalent statement. Older plausible articles were accessible only as abstracts; this limits, but does not itself contradict, the best-knowledge originality conclusion.

value.rationale: A natural irreversible dimer system on a perfectly matchable, dense, three-type substrate has zero thermodynamic unmatched density but a diverging sqrt N jammed population with a closed-form folded-normal law. This resolves the scale and shape of finite-size kinetic obstruction exactly at a tied-reservoir boundary, which fixed-part macroscopic laws do not quantify.
